text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Getting bigger is such a wonderful and 
happy thing! Trainer also told me that 
I'll get stronger.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But... the "feeling of running" has 
changed from before. My running might end 
up being awkward...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
However... if it's us who have worked this 
hard up until now, we can overcome 
anything! That's how my Trainer helped me 
look forward!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Sky-san got soaked in 
the rain... Maybe I should make some warm 
soup? I really hope she doesn't catch a 
cold!
